column3: MT 45:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; עַל־ שֹׁשַׁנִּים is translated “Set to ‘The Lilies,’” “a maskil” is “A Contemplation,” רָחַשׁ (“stirs”) “is overflowing,” and NKJV capitalizes “the King.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV capitalizes “Your lips… You” as messianic.
Close to the Hebrew; “on behalf of truth” is rendered “because of truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV reorders the lines, joining “in the heart of the King’s enemies” to “Your arrows are sharp.”
Close to the Hebrew; שֵׁבֶט מִישֹׁר (“of uprightness”) is rendered “of righteousness.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “scented with,” and מִנִּי (“strings”) is rendered “by which.”
Close to the Hebrew; שֵׁגַל (“the queen consort”) is rendered “the queen.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV capitalizes “King… He… your Lord.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “will come,” and “entreat your face” is rendered “seek your favor.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV adds “the palace” to “within,” and “settings of gold” is rendered “woven with gold.”
Close to the Hebrew; לִרְקָמוֹת (“embroidered garments”) is rendered “robes of many colors.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the land” is rendered “the earth.”
